clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for chemically setting silicate type of chemical resistant mortars for bonding chemical resistant mansonry units. Such mortars are resistant to most type of acids except hydrofluoric acid and concentrated orthophosphoric acids. They are not resistant to alkalis or to boiling water and steam. They deteriorate by continued exposure to water.

clauses.title: Binder
clauses.text: 2.1 Binder — Solution of sodium silicate or potassium silicate with silica/sodium oxide or silica/potassium oxide molecular  ratio of 3 to 3.7. Specific gravity 1.4.

clauses.title: Fillers
clauses.text: 2.2 Fillers — Silica, quartz, ganister, andesite, etc.

clauses.title: Selling Agent
clauses.text: 2.3 Selling Agent — Fluoride or acid compound.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.text: 4. Chemical Requirements — Limits of chemical resistance may be settled between the purchaser and the supplier.
